Behalten or Erhalten? German B1 Word-Choice Practice

Practise behalten for keeping and erhalten for receiving in German. Compare common object combinations with translated examples and explained B1 answers.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Understand the difference

Behalten means to keep or retain something already in one's possession. Erhalten often means to receive, especially in more formal language, but it can also mean to preserve. The sentence context determines its meaning. These tasks contrast keeping an existing item with receiving a new one.

Common mistake to avoid

Erhalten does not always mean receive: ein Gebäude erhalten can mean preserving a building. Do not treat the keep/receive contrast as covering every use of the verb.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Compare the meaning and sentence pattern, rather than choosing by English translation alone.

Worked example 1Du kannst die ausgeliehene Karte noch bis Freitag behalten.You can keep the borrowed map until Friday.
Worked example 2Ich habe gestern eine schriftliche Antwort erhalten.I received a written reply yesterday.
Worked example 3Wir behalten die alten Stühle für den Garten.We keep the old chairs for the garden.
Worked example 4Die Schule erhält eine neue Bücherspende.The school receives a new donation of books.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose behalten for retaining an existing item and erhalten for receiving in the stated context. Use the infinitive or participle as supplied. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Ich möchte diese Erinnerung für immer ___. (keep)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: behalten

Behalten expresses retaining something one already has.

Question 2. Wir haben eine Bestätigung per Post ___. (received)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: erhalten

Erhalten means received in this message context.

Question 3. Den Rest des Stoffes können wir ___. (keep for later)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: behalten

Behalten is retaining the remaining material.

Question 4. Sie hat zum Abschied viele Briefe ___. (received)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: erhalten

Erhalten is the participle for receiving the letters.

Use it in your own sentence

Contrast receiving a receipt with keeping it afterwards.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Ich erhalte einen Beleg und behalte ihn für meine Unterlagen.

Check your wording: Erhalten means receiving here; behalten means retaining what is already received.

What to practise next

Write a new context for each word. Explain which meaning or object pattern makes your choice natural; some contexts allow both.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
